author: SciShow
description:
If your ulcer is caused by a bacteria instead of stress, that means you need an anti-bacterial drug to treat it, right? Well, there's a lot of research supporting the simple fix of cabbage juice, thanks to it's secret ingredient: vitamin U.

Hosted by: @NotesByNiba (she/her)
